evidence.coreClaim: Guru measures religion by clean conduct, not impressive performance. Gurbani keeps repair close to humility, remembrance, and return instead of theatre.
evidence.turn: The language of devotion can get ahead of the life carrying it. The wound or failure has already happened, and the next task is to return truthfully instead of rehearsing despair.
evidence.practicalImplication: Ask whether your next action can bear the words your mouth is using. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.

practice.label: Steady Practice
practice.title: Building a truer practice of conduct
practice.issueStatement: The language of devotion can get ahead of the life carrying it. The deeper need is a form of return that can outlast novelty, urgency, and mood.
practice.centralInsight: Guru measures religion by clean conduct, not impressive performance. The teaching becomes durable when it is practiced repeatedly enough to change posture.
practice.practicalReflection: Practice matters because the heart is always being trained by something; Gurbani asks what pattern is becoming ordinary.
practice.actionPrompt: Ask whether your next action can bear the words your mouth is using. Repeat what you can actually keep.
